quest.title: Shadow of the Past
quest.description: Master Jean has a special task for you. Head to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to find out more.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

chapter.title: The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Thank you for coming on such short notice, Honorary Knight. I know you must be busy.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well, to make a long story short, there is a particular matter at hand that the Knights requires your assistance with.

choices.text: The Knights are busy as ever.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: *sigh* Yes, it has been one thing after another recently. Neither myself nor any of the Mondstadt garrison are able to catch a moment of peace.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I have recently received multiple reports from the Knights of someone within the Lawrence Clan having close dealings with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Fatui! Again!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But who are the Lawrence Clan?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: There was a dark period in Mondstadt's history when the aristocracy ruled over the city. The hard-won freedom that followed with the fall of Decarabian was lost once again, as slavery spread throughout the land.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The first Dandelion Knight, Vennessa, spearheaded the revolution that overthrew the old aristocratic system and established the Knights of Favonius, leading Mondstadt to become the city that you see today.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The aristocrats, that had oppressed the people of Mondstadt, were none other than the Lawrence Clan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it. So the clan's descendants are now scheming with the bad guys to carry out more dubious deeds?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: ...We suspect as much, though we have yet to obtain any solid evidence. The reason I summoned you here today is to ask you to help us further investigate this matter.

choices.text: But, why us?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: *sigh* Unfortunately, the Knights of Favonius and the aristocracy have been at odds with one another for as long as I can remember.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We have already considered every possible way of resolving our differences, but it seems the descendants of the aristocracy remain antagonistic towards the Knights...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: ...No matter what stance we take when dealing with them, the outcome is always the same... Our efforts only result in adding more fuel to the flames.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: We could come knocking on their door on the grounds of a search warrant, but if the investigation were to come up empty, I'm afraid tensions and distrust would only increase.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: All of our past efforts would have been wasted...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But as the Honorary Knight, I technically also belong to the Knights...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: You are in fact the best candidate to represent the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: But you need not emphasize your role as the Honorary Knight. You are a traveler from a distant land, and you can approach the aristocrats in this way.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Once you come to friendly terms with the Lawrence Clan, you should be in a good position to learn more of their possible connections with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, leave it to Master Jean to come up with such a thorough plan.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Aha, perhaps such plans have become second nature after all the diplomatic issues I've dealt with.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The name of the Lawrence Clan member in question is Schubert. Lately, he can often be found strolling near the northern city walls.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It is said that he is difficult to get along with due to his temperamental disposition, but if we approach him calmly, then things should go off without a hitch.

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Thanks again for your help. If you run into any snags along the way, I'll do anything in my power to support you.

choices.text: I hope things will go smoothly.
Sounds like a job for the Knights of Favonius to me.
Sounds like typical Master Jean to me.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I have been meaning to have a word with you if the occasion presented itself, but as you know, Mondstadt's safety must always be my first priority.

talks.objective: Look for the former aristocrat in the city

dialogues.text: Huh? Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, we're here to...
Hmph... "Hello"?

choices.text: Uh, hello...

response.text: Did I hear you correctly? "Hello"?
Hmph! And I suppose you think that you can simply strut up here and greet me in such an ignoble and vulgar manner?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Given that I don't recognize you, I can only assume that you are a traveler of some variety. I'll have you know that you are speaking with the Schubert Lawrence, a blood descendant of the magnanimous nobility.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: If you wish to address me, you'd best consider your words more carefully. Such nonchalant manners are inadmissible and will never do.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Now, if you're somehow capable of understanding anything I've said, then you will get down on your knees, apologize for your negligent actions, and give me a proper introduction. That is the appropriate etiquette!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's etiquette? Paimon's never heard of something so complicated before!

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Hmph, in former times when people knew their place and respected traditions, such conduct was only basic courtesy when greeting a nobleman.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: And neglecting your manners would result in a swift whipping.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: *sigh* But look at the world now, rules have been thrown to the wayside and manners forgotten. Ugh, I cannot bear to see such degradation.

choices.text: Sounds like too much hassle to me...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: What did you say? You dare question the dignity of the nobility?

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: I'll have you know that though the Lawrence Clan is in decline, myself and others of noble blood are looking for a chance to restore our rightful honor.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Just look around, the people are unruly and undisciplined! I, however, strive to retain the elegance and etiquette of the nobility. After all, we are of a completely different breed by birth.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I haven't even said anything yet...

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Save your words, I find your manners and bearing repulsive. I have nothing to discuss with the likes of you.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Besides, I am in no way obligated to instruct commoners on basic courtesies.

response.speaker: Schubert
response.text: Now, I have more pressing matters to attend to. I'll take my leave.

choices.text: It's no wonder the aristocracy fell.
Yeah, what's wrong?

response.text: "What's wrong"? Did you just say "what's wrong"?

talks.objective: Talk to the person by the city wall
Return to the Knights Headquarters and discuss the counterplan

dialogues.text: You don't think twice before reaching for your sword, do you? Ugh... do you have any idea how long I've been tracking these targets?
...And now you get to stake a claim. Hmph, you think you're stronger because you got to them first? Ugh... mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uh, what?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, vengeance?
That's right. I heard the commotion and came as swiftly as I could, only to find you two already fighting the Fatui. Not only that, you were making quick work of them, too!
If I didn't make my move, you would have been able to take all the credit!
Still, I'm glad you're unscathed. Confronting that number of Fatui at once can be dangerous.

choices.text: Actually, I'm quite used to fighting the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Sorry, Paimon doesn't understand what you mean... but thanks for your concern.
Concern? Why would I be concerned for the safety of my arch-enemies?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Arch-enemies"? Wait a minute! You were saying how glad you were that we were "unscathed" a second ago!
By which I meant, if you were injured, I'd have to escort two strangers guilty of stealing my targets all the way back to Mondstadt...
Which would mean you'd caused me even more trouble... my vengeance would be swifter still!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So that's how you see all this!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you must be Eula?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Yes, that's me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks she's pretty strange... Although, at least we can communicate with her.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You dare to call someone you've just met "strange"? Forget the aristocracy, that's rude even by normal standards!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Speaking of which... how do you know my name?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius. And speaking of rude, we're trying to investigate an aristocrat named Schubert Lawrence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's so obsessed with etiquette that he's not even willing to speak with us!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hahaha! I understand now. That's my uncle alright.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But why do you mean to investigate him?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He may be secretly involved with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I see... Haha, you have some nerve defaming a family member right in front of me. I will have vengeance for this, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, no! This is an assignment from Master Jean! It's just an investigation, that's all!

choices.text: Aren't you curious about your uncle?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: To the everyday citizens of Mondstadt, everyone in the Lawrence clan is scum. It's natural for rumors and unwarranted gossip to lead to such suspicion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hard to avoid such a reputation when you're known as the ruthless rulers of Old Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: So that's what you think of me? Yet another transgression to avenge...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But didn't you say it first!? Argh...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hahaha, curious... We've only just met, and you've already given me three causes for vengeance. It's been a while since I've encountered anyone as interesting as you.

choices.text: Your definition of curious is... curious.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I assume you need me to teach you the conduct of the Lawrence clan. Only then will you finally be able to communicate with my uncle, correct?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, Amber told us to come and talk to you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Well then, let's begin your training immediately. It'll be easier to train when we're back in Mondstadt, we'll require other people.

choices.text: But aren't you plotting vengeance against us?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: We can put that aside for now. Besides, if it's the Acting Grand Master's assignment, and Amber's the one who recommended me, I should comply.

choices.text: You're not planning to take revenge at an opportune moment, are you?
Why do you seem so happy about it?
Aren't you worried about your uncle?
I know my way around a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Well, if it isn't the Honorary Knight! I'm just on my way out to gather some intel. I didn't expect to run into you here!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Huh? Judging by your expression, you must have run into some trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Jean tasked us with a special assignment, but things seem to have run aground for the moment.

choices.text: It's a long story...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: No need to get down on yourself, sometimes things just don't turn out as planned. Even I can't guarantee useful intel every time I'm dispatched.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You just have to keep at it and never give up!

choices.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hehe! Hey, why don't you let me try to help? What's the problem?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Master Jean asked us to build a connection with someone named Schubert Lawrence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it turns out that he's a peculiar character that doesn't listen to anyone... Especially Paimon.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Aha, Schubert, I know him! Let me guess, he said you didn't have any manners.

choices.text: So you heard...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hehehe, I've been on the receiving end of his lectures many a time. The Lawrence clan can be very particular about such things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... You mean everyone in the Lawrence Clan is just a big headache?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: As aristocrats, they believe there should be a certain distance between themselves and common folk. *sigh* I understand their thinking, but that's just not how things are anymore.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: However, there is one exception among the Lawrence Clan. My good buddy — Eula!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—Buddy?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: That's right! Not only is she from the Lawrence Clan, but she's also Captain of the Knights of Favonius 4th Company.

choices.text: Jean told us that the Lawrence Clan sees the Knights as enemies.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Eula is special! She's not quite like the other members of her clan. She has her own beliefs and it shows.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: In other words, she doesn't really adhere to the strict rules and conventions of her family.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: However, she's still quite knowledgeable about dealing with the Lawrences. I'm sure you'll see what I mean if you meet her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's strange. If Eula is a member of the Lawrence Clan, then why would Master Jean choose us for the task? Couldn't she just ask Eula?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ah, well... It's a little complicated. Basically, the Lawrence clan has frowned upon the fact that Eula joined the Knights, her family members don't particularly care for her...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: In their eyes, Eula is nothing but a traitor to the family.

choices.text: She sounds like quite the character.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: She's very easy to get along with. Just explain the situation and I'm sure she'll help you come up with a way to get along with Schubert.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: In fact, I think she's out in the wilderness on patrol this morning. You should be able to find her around Stormbearer Mountains.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Amber! Alright, you heard her, let's go find Eula!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Good luck, you two! I've got my own matters to investigate!

choices.text: I guess that's understandable from their point of view...
How could a member of the Lawrence Clan join the Knights?
Sounds like you're no stranger to his rants...
That's Amber for you.
It wasn't our fault.

talks.objective: Go to the Stormbearer Mountains and find Eula

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Schubert can be quite touchy, so it may not be easy to get along with him at first.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But as long as matters remain calm, then you should be able to come to friendly terms with him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Schubert...

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: You mean that weird old aristocrat? I'm afraid I haven't seen him.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Members of the Lawrence Clan don't usually appear in front of the Knights of Favonius of their own accord.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Which is just as well. It would be a bother if it ended up affecting our logistical preparations.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Head up and have a look. Who knows, you might just find him.

talks.objective: Witness the young woman defeat the final Fatuus

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, have you seen an aristocrat by the name of Schubert anywhere nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Hmm, the name doesn't ring a bell, but there has been an odd fellow strolling around here recently.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: He's always looking around, and sometimes he seems to stop to draw or note something down. To be honest, I've got no idea what he's up to.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: If that sounds like the person you're looking for, just head towards the city wall and you'll most likely run into him.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Head to the Stormbearer Mountains — you should be able to find Eula there!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: She's a great friend of mine. She'll help you for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is what Master Jean meant by "difficult to get along with"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let's head back and talk things over with her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who would've guessed the Knights have a member of the Lawrence Clan...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if you want to learn about the conduct of the Lawrence clan, who better to ask than one of their own family members?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, the Fatui? What are they doing here! Is that why Eula was sent on patrol here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... let's fight first and talk later!
